# Install Demo Common

Only confirmed public destinations are listed. Each destination has independent release history.

## demo-common: demo-common

Choose one publishing destination and one dependency syntax.

### maven-central

Repository: **maven-central**. Confirmed version **0.1.2**. [Source commit](https://github.com/lambdawalker/android.apexfission.demo-common/commit/11d3cdce31c481fe2204f00d25b5fd93e5f9a18c).

#### Gradle Kotlin DSL

In `settings.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
dependencyResolutionManagement {
    repositories {
        google()
        mavenCentral()
    }
}
```

In the app's `build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
dependencies {
    implementation("com.apexfission.android:demo-common:0.1.2")
}
```

#### Gradle Groovy DSL

In `settings.gradle`:

```groovy
dependencyResolutionManagement {
    repositories {
        google()
        mavenCentral()
    }
}
```

In the app's `build.gradle`:

```groovy
dependencies {
    implementation 'com.apexfission.android:demo-common:0.1.2'
}
```

#### Version catalog

Use the dependency repositories shown above. Add to `gradle/libs.versions.toml`:

```toml
[libraries]
demo-common = { module = "com.apexfission.android:demo-common", version = "0.1.2" }
```

Then use this instead of the direct dependency in the app's `build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
dependencies {
    implementation(libs.demo.common)
}
```

#### Maven

Add these repositories and dependency to `pom.xml`:

```xml
<repositories>
  <repository>
    <id>google</id>
    <url>https://dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2</url>
  </repository>
  <repository>
    <id>central</id>
    <url>https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2</url>
  </repository>
</repositories>
<dependencies>
  <dependency>
    <groupId>com.apexfission.android</groupId>
    <artifactId>demo-common</artifactId>
    <version>0.1.2</version>
    <type>aar</type>
  </dependency>
</dependencies>
```

### jitpack

Repository: **jitpack**. Confirmed version **0.1.2**. [Source commit](https://github.com/lambdawalker/android.apexfission.demo-common/commit/86b43bd7ee858ceb09642ec755f0dc99e7eb5a2f).

#### Gradle Kotlin DSL

In `settings.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
dependencyResolutionManagement {
    repositories {
        google()
        mavenCentral()
        maven { url = uri("https://jitpack.io") }
    }
}
```

In the app's `build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
dependencies {
    implementation("com.github.lambdawalker:android.apexfission.demo-common:demo-common~v0.1.2-jitpack")
}
```

#### Gradle Groovy DSL

In `settings.gradle`:

```groovy
dependencyResolutionManagement {
    repositories {
        google()
        mavenCentral()
        maven { url 'https://jitpack.io' }
    }
}
```

In the app's `build.gradle`:

```groovy
dependencies {
    implementation 'com.github.lambdawalker:android.apexfission.demo-common:demo-common~v0.1.2-jitpack'
}
```

#### Version catalog

Use the dependency repositories shown above. Add to `gradle/libs.versions.toml`:

```toml
[libraries]
demo-common = { module = "com.github.lambdawalker:android.apexfission.demo-common", version = "demo-common~v0.1.2-jitpack" }
```

Then use this instead of the direct dependency in the app's `build.gradle.kts`:

```kotlin
dependencies {
    implementation(libs.demo.common)
}
```

#### Maven

Add these repositories and dependency to `pom.xml`:

```xml
<repositories>
  <repository>
    <id>google</id>
    <url>https://dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2</url>
  </repository>
  <repository>
    <id>central</id>
    <url>https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2</url>
  </repository>
  <repository>
    <id>confirmed-2</id>
    <url>https://jitpack.io</url>
  </repository>
</repositories>
<dependencies>
  <dependency>
    <groupId>com.github.lambdawalker</groupId>
    <artifactId>android.apexfission.demo-common</artifactId>
    <version>demo-common~v0.1.2-jitpack</version>
    <type>aar</type>
  </dependency>
</dependencies>
```
